source_note: Wikimedia Commons "File:Access Virus C .jpg" (2930x1240, CC BY-SA 2.0): near straight-on top view, knobs fitted, LEDs and display lit. Cross-checked on the bare faceplate, Access_Virus_C_Desktop_-6875867395-.jpg (Commons / Flickr, CC BY 2.0), mapped onto the rectified master with SIFT + RANSAC and a cubic warp fitted to local template matches (median residual 0.6 px). Scale from the display module and the panel PCB photo (6875865237); see panel.md.
origin: top-left (rear-left) corner of the top view including the end caps; x right, y towards the player (down on screen)
px_per_mm_in_source_note: in rectified master px; the raw master has ~6.02 px/mm across and ~6.23 down (its y is stretched 3.4 %)

frame.mapping: master px -> rectified px R: (1) radial lens term about (1029.1, 1520.8) px, k1 0.00556, k2 -0.00015 (r in units of 1000 px); (2) projective terms g1 0.00401, g2 -0.00550; (3) shear a12 -0.00359, a21 0.00614; (4) y scaled by 0.9661 so the printed dot rings are circles. Then mm = (R - origin) / 6.02.
frame.rectification: fitted so that 39 traced straight print lines (section rules and bars, box edges, display frame, case lip) are straight and level/plumb: rms 0.35 px over all trace points (1.15 px before). The aspect factor comes from 32 dot rings (rms 0.23 px).
frame.scale: px_per_mm 6.02 +-0.05 (+-0.8 %): display character pitch 21.25 R px for the standard 3.55 mm (5.99), PCB DIP pin pitch 2.54 mm mapped through the pots (6.07, 10 rows), 2x20 header (5.95). Width 470.9 +-3.5 mm.
frame.camera_distance_note: from the knob-top parallax (2.82 %) and a knob height of 16.5-17.5 mm: 600-640 mm
frame.parallax_note: raised parts lean outwards from parallax_centre by height/(camera_distance - height); knob tops (16.5 mm) by 2.8 % of their distance from it. All centres here are panel-plane positions.

panel.note: measured top view 470.9 x 181.1 mm (end caps included, rear jacks excluded). zZounds' 470 mm width matches; its 185 mm depth plausibly includes the rear sockets. The Spectrasonics figures do not fit the photos (aspect 1.52 against 2.60).

accuracy: printed features and knob centres +-0.2 mm relative (master and bare plate agree to 0.05-0.25 mm on the dot rings); LEDs +-0.3 mm; buttons +-0.4 mm; legends +-0.2 mm (bbox, includes ~0.1 mm blur per side); case edges, caps and lip +-1 mm; absolute scale +-0.8 %; 3-D sizes (knob height, cap height) +-1.5 mm; rear panel +-2 mm in x, +-3 mm in y

_white_balance.note: 2026-11-10: the plate, case, knobs and buttons were re-measured from four photos with neutral surroundings (a studio shot on white, three listing photos in daylight and room light; private/virusc/docs/photos/colour), each white-balanced so the legend print is neutral and scaled to it. The first values, from the lamp-lit master, came out brown. LED and LCD colours are still the master's.

fonts.panel_legends: wide geometric sans capitals with rounded-square bowls (Eurostile Extended / Microgramma-like); the figure 1 is a bare stem with a small flag, so "1+2", "LFO 1", "FILTER 1" look stem-like. Legend cap height ~2.3 mm, titles (LFOS / MOD, OSCILLATORS, ...) ~3.2 mm, small sub-legends (AUDITION, PANIC, DEMO, BANK, CATEGORY, PROGRAM) ~1.6-1.8 mm.
fonts.knob_numbers: same face, ~1.9 mm figures: 6 at the top and 0 / 12 at the scale ends, or the knob's own marks (-48 / 0 / 48, 1 / 1+2 / 2, -6 / 0 / 6, - / +)
fonts.arrows: PART and PARAMETER have solid triangles (shown as ◄ ►) at both ends of the legend
fonts.lcd: 5x7 dot-matrix characters of an HD44780-type controller (red on dark)
fonts.logos: Brand marks (maker emblem + wordmark, model lettering, tagline) are slots only, filled from the user's artwork places (maker, name, tagline); nothing here traces them.

conventions.text: bbox = ink bounding box (includes ~0.1 mm blur per side); x,y = bbox centre; cap_h = bbox height - 0.2
conventions.knob: x,y = centre of the printed dot ring (= shaft); d = ring outer diameter; scale.marks = 13 positions step_deg apart from -6*step to +6*step (0 = up, clockwise positive); dot_marks = positions that carry a dot; labels at their marks; knob_d / cap_d / height = knob body, top, height above the plate
conventions.button: x,y,w,h = the square cap centred in its panel cut-out (parallax removed); cutout_bbox = the panel opening (pairs and triples share one opening)
conventions.led: x,y = LED centre (panel hole), d = 3 mm
conventions.line: points = stroke centre line; stroke = width
conventions.outline_box: bbox = outer edge of the stroke
conventions.param: interactive elements carry a param hint; knobs carry mame_knob (MAME ADC index = channel*4 + mux), buttons mame_key [row, bit] where the match is clear
conventions.matrix: LED: column (P5 bits 0-2), latch A or B, bit (docs/firmware.md, "LEDs and key scan"); button: mame_key [row, bit] of the key matrix, checked by pressing each on the firmware

rear_panel.source: private/virusc/docs/photos/Access_Virus_C_Desktop_-6875895299-.jpg (straight-on rear view, 2048x637); legends read on it
rear_panel.note: Seen from behind, so the order is reversed: x is in TOP-PANEL coordinates (mm from the left end as seen from the front). The top panel prints the jack names along its rear edge, each above its jack (text_midi_thru ... text_on_off). x = rear-photo jack centre mapped to the frame by a linear fit to those top legends (scale -0.235 mm/px, rms 0.52 mm); x_top_legend = the printed legend's centre. y_from_top = mm below the rear face's top edge, from the rear photo at ~4.23 px/mm, +-3 mm.

face.legends: light grey, above each jack; a large outline maker emblem and the model lettering are printed on the rear face (marks, not described), plus "MADE IN GERMANY" and a serial-number plate

ui_suggestions.note: In the master the knob tops lean outwards from about (249, 92) mm by 2.8 % of their distance (up to 6 mm at the ends); draw raised parts centred on their elements.
MAME drives the LEDs as a 16 x 8 matrix; the mapping of matrix bits to these 69 LEDs is still to be found from the firmware.
Draw the display from the emulated HD44780 character RAM at char_origin / pitches; the panel photo shows "1 VOCODER / Mode Off" with a custom arrow glyph in the last cell.
